full.description: This image is a photomicrograph of a tissue sample, likely showing a small artery or blood vessel exhibiting fibrinoid necrosis. The dark pink, homogeneous condensation visible in the walls of the small vessels represents necrotic changes. Surrounding the vessels is an inflammatory infiltrate and connective tissue. This histopathological finding is often associated with conditions such as preeclampsia or vasculitis.

random.description: This is a high-power photomicrograph of a vascular lesion, likely from soft tissue or another organ. The image displays epithelioid endothelial cells embedded within a distinctive myxoid or hyaline stroma, forming cords and nests. Luminal formation within some of the nests can be observed alongside mild inflammatory infiltrates. These features are characteristic of epithelioid hemangioendothelioma.
captions: Epithelioid hemangioendothelioma usually contains myxoid stroma and epithelioid cells in nests.
